title: CANYON-MED
description: Updated version of CANYON-MED in which the decimal year input has been removed from the neural networks used to estimate nutrient concentrations (nitrate, phosphate and silicate). This modification aims to limit potential biases associated with temporal extrapolation beyond 2018, the last year represented in the original training dataset. The original hyperparameters and ensemble of ten neural networks are retained, with new weights obtained through retraining. This version builds on the original CANYON-MED method described by Fourrier et al. (2020) and its corrigendum (2021). It was developed for applications to the BioSWOT-Med study.
